units.source_text: 店铺快要打烊时，千重子在账房前坐下。

en.t: When the shop was about to close, Chieko sat down in front of the accounts desk.

units.source_text: 这是一间古色古香的账房，四周用低矮的格子围上。

en.t: It was an old-fashioned accounts area, enclosed on all sides by low latticework.

units.source_text: 植村掌柜觉察到千重子异乎寻常的举止，便问道：

en.t: Noticing that Chieko was acting unusually, the head clerk Uemura asked:
